component.name: UAD Shizuku
component.summary: Universal Android Debloater with Shizuku support

description.p: UAD-Shizuku is a cross-platform application for managing Android devices. It allows you to selectively remove bloatware apps, scan installed FOSS apps with VirusTotal, and install FOSS apps through Obtainium integration.

ul.li: Debloat applications with curated bloat app lists
Get SHA256 checksums of installed apps and scan with VirusTotal API
Browse and install Android FOSS apps from OFFA and FMHY lists via Obtainium
Support for both ADB wireless (Shizuku) and platform-tools
Cross-platform: Linux, macOS, Windows, and Android

description.p: Latest release with improved stability and features
